Research profile

I develop learning methods and software for systems that have to make decisions under changing conditions. My work spans cloud–edge resource management, evidence-based agent workflows, and reproducible ML engineering.

Industry collaboration & supervision

Supervised 10 partner-facing Master of Data Science projects involving approximately 50 postgraduate students. Responsibilities included problem formulation, method selection, technical review, evaluation, partner demonstrations, and handover.

  • AURIN: Supervised the geospatial metadata-assessment project and co-developed AgentFAIR’s research workflows.
  • John Holland Group: Guided RAG and dashboard prototypes for lessons-learnt and intranet collections.
  • Lithodat: Supervised rock-classification comparisons, spatial usage dashboards, and domain-assistant concepts.
  • Melbourne Dental School: Supervised sentiment and aspect analysis to support improvements to interactive educational materials.
  • VIMI: Guided video-captioning and post-production prototypes with a user-facing interface.
